_comment: TEMPLATE — copied by the bootstrap card (/jairus:ship) to the product's .claude/settings.json if missing. Registers the jairus marketplace and enables the plugin for the team. The permission list is deliberately narrow: local build, test and git-commit work runs without prompts, while anything that leaves the machine or creates cloud resources (git push, git remote, gh, every MCP write: neon create/SQL/branch tools, the github/vercel/stripe servers) still asks, so the human gates (rules/gates.md, Gate P) cannot be bypassed by a pre-approved command. Only the read-only neon tools are pre-approved. Loosen it per project if you accept that. The marketplace repo is Nani-Bobbara_CUDL/jairus-plugin (private: each user needs read access).
